## Key Projects
- [Shiksha Saathi](https://github.com/monojitgoswami69/Shiksha_Saathi): Production-ready RAG chatbot for academic institutions with dynamic prompt management, confidence gating, and human handoff.
- [Campus Dost](https://github.com/monojitgoswami69/campus-dost): Multi-tenant SaaS evolution of Shiksha Saathi featuring isolated vector stores, multi-role RBAC, and institution-specific tenant configs.
- [Codalyzer](https://github.com/monojitgoswami69): LLM-driven static code complexity analyzer providing Big-O runtime & space complexity estimations with optimization recommendations.
